Description: Let students request interview times with recruiters for selected jobs.

Description: Let recruiters browse applicants and request interviews with students.

Description: Support applicant-to-recruiter, recruiter-to-applicant, or both booking directions.

Description: Prevent active sessions from changing event direction while the event is live.
Notes / Acceptance: Admin must unlock before changing booking direction.

Description: Generate recruiter interview slots from event time frame, slot duration, buffer, and interviewer count.

Description: Let applicants expose availability for recruiter-initiated booking mode.
Notes / Acceptance: Applicant slots can be booked by recruiters when mode allows.

Description: Use database transactions and row locking to avoid double-booked interview slots.

Description: Track waitlisted applications when a desired time cannot be immediately confirmed.

Description: Allow recruiters to accept, reject, or waitlist student applications.

Description: Let recruiters suggest alternate interview times for pending or waitlisted applications.
Notes / Acceptance: Student receives actionable proposal with Accept/Decline; accepted proposal claims a real slot.

Description: Warn recruiters when a proposed time overlaps the student's confirmed interviews at other companies.
Notes / Acceptance: Recruiters see busy ranges but not the other company/position; override is allowed for applicant-busy only.

Description: Show every student's applications/interviews on `/profile` with company, job, status, and time.
Notes / Acceptance: Statuses include pending, waitlisted, reschedule proposed, accepted, rejected, and cancelled.

Description: Let admin enable or disable student-initiated application/interview cancellation.

Description: Allow admin to correct requested/proposed/confirmed booking times without manual SQL.

Description: Record proposal, retract, accept, decline, blocked, and admin correction events.

Description: Recruiters maintain company name, industry, contact email, website, description, logo, gallery, and interviewer count.

Description: Upload recruiter logos for directory, job cards, and company pages.

Description: Upload multiple company photos for the public company profile.

Description: Recruiters configure number of parallel interviewers for slot capacity.

Description: Recruiters submit jobs for admin review before public listing when moderation is enabled.

Description: Allow recruiters to publish and unpublish directly when admin disables job moderation.

Description: Recruiters view applications and interview statuses for their company.

Description: Show confirmed interviews in schedule-oriented format for event-day operations.

Description: Let recruiters browse applicant profiles and book candidates directly when event mode allows.

Description: Show registrations, recruiters, applicants, bookings, job volume, and operational health in one place.

Description: Compare each company's interview slot supply against booking-request demand buckets.

Description: Configure event name, email name, tagline, organizer, venue, display date, and hero copy.

Description: Configure event date, start/end time, slot duration, and buffer minutes.

Description: Configure event mode, lock state, fallback, and student cancellation behavior.
